reply_text:
Nadia, I posted the list as a reply in your thread on #strategic-pod. I found three Vantorre Group tickets and one unconfirmed candidate, from #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and Moss's Strategic digests. I left Mobility out.

- **#8841** (also written #PD-8841), gate kiosk timeout:
  - It appears in #strategic-pod (Jul 1 2026) and in the 2026-04-27, 2026-05-04 and 2026-09-30 digests.
  - The records conflict. Gideon says he closed it on Jul 1, but the Sep 30 digest has it escalated to platform engineering. The plant is Allentown in some entries and Newark in others. Check the support system before the steering committee.
- **INC-4821**, Hartford status-page access issue: #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 2026.
- **VT-55120**, root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage: #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14 2026. I haven't opened the ticket.
- **#PD-4418**, a Carrier_Dwell_Summary export problem, is the unconfirmed one. The 2025-09-15 digest only says "the account Nadia runs" and never names Vantorre.

A few digest entries describe Vantorre issues without a ticket number, so I left them off the list. I also only read those three sources, so this isn't the full ticket history. Anything that exists only in the support system won't be here.
